info.description: Event-driven risk signals and deterministic portfolio stress testing. Replay profile: real source documents through the ingestion pipeline (trained sentiment and event models; impact is a trained, labelled model where one can score a signal and a labelled placeholder rule elsewhere); demo profile: fixtures. The stress engine is real in both.
info.title: EventShock API

post.description:
Analyse pasted text through the same engine as the live feed. Always 200 for a usable request: ``outcome`` says what happened
(a text that cannot be scored is ``QUARANTINED`` with the reason, never given a guessed value).

get.description:
How far the numbers can be trusted.

Stage status, data foundation, feature availability, the incremental-value study and the
representation comparison. Read-only: built once at start-up from the loaded model cards and
the committed evidence files. A section whose evidence file does not exist says so and names
the command that produces it; nothing is computed or invented per request.

post.description: Poll the source once now. 409 when live is off. A failed poll is reported in the status, not as an HTTP error.

get.description: The live feed's health, honestly: OFF by default; DEGRADED / ERROR when the source fails (replay data keeps serving).
The event model card: training data, abstention, per-class reliability, scores and failure modes.
The impact model card: per-scope lifecycle, baselines vs model, calibration, acceptance, limits.

default scenario's shocks bind to this kind of event. Exposure is the book's own; nothing here is a forecast.
